hub.name: HMO Hub
hub.summary: Facilitates access to healthcare services covered by your health insurance plan.
hub.hours: 6 AM – 7 PM (Monday to Saturday), 6 AM – 2 PM (Sunday and Holidays)

onlineApproval.label: HMO Online Approval
onlineApproval.blurb: Need HMO approval for your check-up, lab tests, or procedures? Skip the long lines and get approved online quick and easy.

steps.title: Check your coverage
steps.text: Confirm with your HMO that PDH and your doctor are accredited for the service you need. Your doctor’s profile lists the HMOs they accept.

steps.title: Go to the HMO Hub
steps.text: Bring your HMO card, a valid ID, and your doctor’s request. The Hub is on the Ground Floor.

steps.title: Get your approval
steps.text: The Hub coordinates your Letter of Authorization (LOA). For outpatient services you can also request approval online before you come.

steps.title: Proceed to your service
steps.text: Present your approval at the clinic, laboratory, or imaging desk. Any amount not covered is settled at the cashier.

philhealth.statement: PDH is accredited by the Department of Health (DOH), PhilHealth, and various Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs).
sampleSteps: Bring your PhilHealth ID or Member Data Record (MDR) and a valid ID.
Submit the forms at Admitting (inpatient) or the service desk (outpatient).
Your PhilHealth benefit is deducted from the bill before discharge.
